title: iARCS: Iterative Agentic RL for Controllable 3D Scene Generation
abstract: Synthetic 3D scene generation is increasingly used as a data source for computer vision and embodied AI, but existing generators often optimize perceptual realism without reliably satisfying task-critical functional constraints. This mismatch limits the usefulness of synthetic data for downstream training, where accessibility, traversability, and spatial rule compliance are often essential. We present iARCS, an iterative agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts a pretrained scene generator to natural-language task requirements. iARCS uses a two-stage strategy: universal-reward pretraining to improve physical plausibility and layout quality, followed by task-specific fine-tuning with LLM-generated reward programs that are iteratively refined from training feedback. Experiments show improved constraint fidelity on walkability, reachability, and clearance-focused tasks, effective task-specific constraint optimization, and competitive scene diversity. We further show that data generated by iARCS improves a base generator, supporting its value as a practical synthetic data generation tool rather than only a controllable scene editing method.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2608.06161v2 exact-version PDF、文本抽取与页面渲染整理；PDF 共 17 页，SHA-256 395d18ebdaf36db1acba8bc83ce8d4d44543dbcced9e1edf94e56c08b1605740，视觉核验第 1–4 页。
analysis.ideaZh: iARCS v2 是实质更新：它保留“universal-reward 预训练 + LLM 生成并迭代修正 task reward program”的两阶段 RL 主线，同时把证据扩展到 bedroom、living room、dining room、human preference、task-specific constraints 和 synthetic-data augmentation，而非仅改变版本戳。
methodFlow: Task-specific policy and constrained scene generation
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它把自然语言需求、executable geometric constraints、rendered feedback 与 RL 连成 agentic 3D design loop；v2 的跨 room-type 与 human-study 证据提高了对 controllable scene generation 的参考价值。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者在 Table 2（p.7）报告：bedroom 上 iARCS 的 object/scene collision 为 40.45%/64.63%、reachability 87.82%、walkability 0.861；living room 的 scene collision 65.5%、walkability 0.955；dining room 的 object collision 51.34%、reachability 73.18%。Figure 4（p.7）的人类偏好实验由 21 名参与者比较 constraint-filtered 3D-FRONT 与 iARCS scenes，三个任务的 iARCS preference 分别为 71%、63%、52%。这些均为作者报告，本项目未复现。
analysis.caveatZh: reward quality 依赖 LLM task decomposition 与 reward-code correctness；每类任务仍需独立 LoRA/RL optimization，不是 prompt-time zero-shot generator。实验限于 3D-FRONT 的三个室内 room types，human study 规模为 21 人，simulator/reward coverage 与更开放场景的外推仍有限。
analysis.motivationZh: 视觉分布逼真的 3D scene generator 仍可能产生 collision、out-of-bound、不可行走或不可达布局；iARCS 的目标是把自然语言功能需求编译成可执行 reward，并在保留 scene prior 与 diversity 的同时改善 task-critical constraints。
analysis.methodZh: Stage 1 用 collision、boundary、density、walkability 与 reachability 等 universal rewards，经 DDPO/LoRA 修正 pretrained scene diffusion prior；Stage 2 由 LLM 分解用户约束并合成 reward program，再读取 rollout statistics 和 renders 迭代修正 reward/curriculum，得到 task-specific policy。两阶段顺序训练用于避免从初始 prior 同时优化所有 reward 的不稳定。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者将 iARCS 与 ATISS、MiDiffusion 及 3D-FRONT ground truth 比较，报告三个 room types 的 collision、out-of-bound、reachability、walkability、FID 与 SCA；另以 21 人 preference study、三个 task-specific constraint、4,000 个生成 scenes 的 data augmentation 以及 single-stage/two-stage 和 reward-refinement ablations 核证。结果显示 physical/functional metrics 普遍改善但 FID/SCA 并非全面领先，因而证据支持“constraint fidelity 提升”，不支持无条件的 realism SOTA。
analysis.insightZh: v2 的关键 scientific delta 是把原先较窄的 bedroom 定量证据扩为多 room-type、human preference、data augmentation 与更完整 ablation。更可迁移的观点是：agent 不必直接放置每个 object，也可以充当 reward compiler 与 debugger；代价则是 per-task training 和 reward-specification risk。
